newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: RESEARCH ALERT-Bavaria upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bavaria upgraded to buy.

text.p: ING Barings said it was upgrading Colombian brewing giant Bavaria to buy from hold because of expectations of an increase in operating income and strong second quarter results.
"Bavaria's upcoming 'share split' is likely to give the stock a run on expectations," said Alejandra Torres, ING Barings's head of Colombia equity research.
She added that Bavaria's results were expected to "outperform those of most Colombian companies covered by ING Barings, especially cement producers and banks."
Torres said she had set Bavaria's 12-month target price at US$9.30 per share, representing a total expected return of 31 percent to June 1998.
Bavaria's share split, originally expected to happen in April, would reflect a formal division between the company's investment activities and its brewery and beverage operations.
The company, which is Colombia's largest private firm, is the flagship of the powerful Julio Mario Santo Domingo conglomerate.
